classificationReason: The test failed at navigation step (Step 7 of TC), not at the designed-to-fail assertion step (Steps 22/23). MCP exploration (Phase 3a, 2026-05-19T14:26:38Z) confirmed SAP Fiori fully loads and the search button appears correctly — the issue is that the Playwright runner's 30-second wait for [title='Open Search'] expires before the post-login redirect and SAP shell bar rendering completes. This is a script timing bug, not a SAP application defect.

mcpEvidence.sapBehavior: SAP Fiori home page loaded successfully; search button clicked; Manage Purchase Orders opened; PO created with all steps completing normally
mcpEvidence.criticalFinding: Alert 'Purchase order has been created.' WITHOUT 10-digit PO number at Step 22 — AC-6 violated

failingLocator.reason: 30s timeout insufficient for post-IDP-redirect + SAP JS framework initialization in non-MCP Playwright run

patchDescription: Increase openSearch() wait timeout from 30000ms to 90000ms. Also add waitForLoadState('networkidle') before waitForSelector to allow full SAP bootstrap completion.

expectedAfterPatch.expectedResult: false (SAP shows alert without PO number)

note: After patching the timeout, TC-CS-021 should reach Step 22 and fail with ASSERTION_FAILURE — the designed-to-fail behavior. That failure will be classified as APP_DEFECT and escalated to Phase 6.
